Our development team boasts members with over 15 years of experience, including key figures such as founding members and team leads who have successfully guided startups to exits exceeding 150 million dollars.

title: Data Consultant Brazil
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.

  • Innovate: You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
  • Learn and Share: You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team’s evolution.
  • Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations: You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
  • Act Across the Project Value Chain: From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
  • Participate in Training: You’ll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
  • Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.

What we are looking for

  • Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
  • Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
  • Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
  • Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
  • Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit : You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Product Designer
description:
SigmaMD aims to make a meaningful contribution to the world by changing the way people manage their health. Our growing engineering and product team has deep expertise in consumer tech. We are combining our diverse backgrounds to innovate in Digital Health.


Our goal is to make millions of lives healthier by using technology. We strive to empower patients to take control of their health care and help clinicians better treat them. To achieve this vision we need an outstanding and passionate Product Designer to take on the following responsibilities:


  • Contribute to high-level product thinking while also developing interaction flows, mockups, and prototypes. 
  • Collaborate in a cross-functional team to understand user needs and business goals, and translate them into intuitive and effective product designs.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to communicate design concepts and gather feedback.
  • Advocate for the needs and preferences of both doctors and patients by conducting user research and gathering feedback from both groups, and incorporating their insights into the design process to ensure the product meets the needs of all stakeholders.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, design best practices, and the latest design tools and technologies to ensure the team is delivering high-quality, cutting-edge products.


This person should share our core values of teamwork, empathy, and innovation. Ideally, they have the following:


  • Know how to define a repeatable and shareable design process that encourages collaboration between design, product, and engineering teams.
  • Ask questions that build or help to clarify the problem statement and ensure that you maintain user focus and empathy.
  • Explore and refine concepts, then narrow to the best solution, weighing technical feasibility and scope with your team.
  • Create and maintain UX and UI deliverables including information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, style guides, micro interaction specifications, and pattern libraries.
  • Influence the product vision leading and participating in research, focused on both the intangibles (emotional needs) and tangibles (functional needs)..
  • Champion usability testing within your product team, capture the team's assumptions, identify the correct test methodology to use, document results, communicate actionable feedback and findings back to the team.
  • Communicate your design rationale to project stakeholders and use data to defend your design choices.


Required Skills

  • 2+ years of product design experience (including equivalent UI and UX focused role).
  • Able to provide samples of work that show creative solutions to complex products, strong visual design, and information architecture.
  • A strong understanding of the entire product development process, from research and problem solving through to detailed UI and visual design.
  • Experience with Figma.
  • Understand how modern technologies are used with design.
  • Believe that product and design decisions are inextricably linked.
  • Enjoy shipping small, quick experiments to explore and validate your ideas.
  • Know how to balance the user experience with technical and business requirements.
  • Able to communicate effectively with all stakeholders. Speak KPIs, OKRs and understand how to rely on data to support your work.
  • Not afraid to learn new things to take on a problem.
  • Are a self-starter who works proactively to solve problems and bring clarity to ambiguity
  • Facilitate both design-focused and cross-functional sessions with ease, relying on your knowledge of facilitation tools and techniques


Desired Skills

  • Have an understanding of front end technologies such as HTML and CSS.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Prior experience in a design related role at a startup.
  • Experience with digital health or relatable areas.
  • Experience working with mobile apps.

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.


Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.

  • During testing, you will collect the necessary data so you can write a test report.
  • The development environment is Red Hat Linux, execution environment is Wind River Linux. The software release driving a client machine is 40 million lines of code. Client SW teams work in various modes such as Agile and SAFE.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • We are looking for colleagues with at least 5 years of development experience.
  • Python: application coding
  • Linux (one of more of the following): familiar with command line tools, makefile, git, shell and python scripting
  • Embedded C and C++: understanding and maintaining legacy code. Adding new features while keeping compliance with established architecture.
  • Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Consultor de Governança

O foco principal será a implementação e gestão do Unity Catalog , estabelecendo políticas de governança que garantam a segurança, conformidade e qualidade dos dados utilizados em modelos de Analytics e Inteligência Artificial.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Unity Catalog: Configurar e administrar o Unity Catalog (Databricks) para garantir o controle de acesso centralizado (lineage, permissões e auditoria).

  • Governança de IA: Estabelecer diretrizes para o uso ético e seguro de modelos de IA, monitorando a qualidade dos dados de entrada (inputs) e a rastreabilidade dos modelos.
  • Segurança e Acessos: Definir e gerenciar perfis de acesso, garantindo que a democratização dos dados ocorra de forma segura.

Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills)

  • Experiência sólida com Databricks e configuração de Unity Catalog .
  • Conhecimento profundo em SQL e linguagens utilizadas em ambiente de dados (Python ou Scala).
  • Vivência com frameworks de Governança de Dados (DAMA-DMBOK, COBIT ou similares).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Catálogo de Dados e Linhagem (Data Lineage).
  • Entendimento de fluxos de MLOps e governança aplicada a modelos de IA.
  • Habilidade excepcional em escrita técnica e documentação.


Diferenciais

  • Certificações Databricks (Certified Data Engineer ou similar).
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Experiência prévia em projetos de migração para ambientes de governança centralizada.


Perfil Desejado (Soft Skills)

  • Perfil Analítico: Capacidade de organizar grandes volumes de informação de forma lógica.
  • Atenção aos Detalhes: Rigor com a padronização e qualidade da documentação.
  • Comunicação Assertiva: Capacidade de explicar políticas complexas de forma simples para diferentes áreas.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Architect

You are a senior-level Azure Cloud Architect who enjoys building secure, scalable, and automated cloud platforms. title: AI Video Editor
description:
Hiring: AI Video Editor / Performance Videographer

Company: Rain Media

Reports to: Creative Director

Status: Full-time Contractor (Global)

Location: Argentina and Brazil, preferred


Position Overview

Are You a Performance-Driven Video Editor Who Knows How to Turn Creative Into Conversions? If you think in hooks, pacing, and paid social performance, and you’re already leveraging AI video tools to produce faster, smarter creative, this role is for you.

At Organics Ocean, we’re looking for an AI-native Video Editor / Performance Videographer who will help scale high-volume direct response creative. This role exists to solve a key business need: increasing creative output, improving execution speed, and reducing revision cycles while elevating the quality of edits through advanced AI workflows.

This is a production-first role focused primarily on editing, post-production, and AI-enhanced creative, not traditional filming.

You will work closely with Creative, Growth, and Marketing partners to deliver performance-focused assets that directly impact campaign velocity.


Who we are: Organics Ocean

We are a premium direct-to-consumer supplement brand helping people live healthier lives through science-backed, clean, and effective products.

We’re not a company where things stay the same. We test, we optimize, we innovate—and we want someone who thrives in that kind of high-accountability, fast-paced environment.


Why join our team?


High-growth eCommerce brand: Driven by innovation and fast execution, Organics Ocean has seen 350% year over year growth.


Ownership & Accountability: We trust our team members to take full ownership of their responsibilities. You are empowered to lead, execute, and improve without micromanagement. We value individuals who take initiative, hold themselves accountable, and drive meaningful results.


A team of high performers: We push boundaries, move fast, and get things done. The company is in a hockey stick growth phase. This is not a good fit for those who don’t want to grow.


Responsibilities

Direct Response Video Editing

  • Produce high-quality paid social performance creatives
  • Execute UGC edits, AI creative, AI UGC, mini-VSL, and VSL formats
  • Optimize pacing, hooks, and CTAs for conversion
  • Deliver high output with minimal revision cycles

AI Video Workflow Integration

  • Use AI tools to accelerate production and improve quality
  • Create both AI-forward and AI-assisted realistic creatives
  • Continuously test new AI workflows to improve performance

Creative Collaboration

  • Partner with Creative Strategy to execute briefs
  • Attend creative meetings to reduce revision loops
  • Align closely with Creative leadership on feedback

Production & Workflow Support

  • Act as a point of contact between Creative Lead and external editors
  • Help disseminate process updates and feedback to contractors
  • Support operational efficiency and creative throughput

Filming (Secondary Responsibility)

  • Occasional product shots or B-roll when needed


What success looks like


First 90 Days

  • Fully ramp into Rain Media’s performance creative workflow and AI editing stack
  • Deliver consistent weekly output aligned to creative briefs and paid social requirements
  • Demonstrate proficiency using required AI tools within real production workflows
  • Reduce revision cycles by actively participating in creative meetings and feedback loops
  • Establish clear collaboration rhythms with Creative leadership and external editors
  • Begin contributing process improvements that increase speed and execution quality

In 12 months:

  • Consistently deliver 15–20 high-performing creatives per week with strong execution speed
  • Become a key leverage point for creative production, supporting communication with external editors and improving workflow efficiency
  • Elevate overall creative quality through advanced AI integration and experimentation
  • Maintain a standard of ≤1 revision cycle between strategy and editing whenever possible
  • Help scale creative volume without sacrificing performance or brand quality
  • Contribute to evolving Rain Media’s AI-first creative production framework


Requirements

Requirements (Expected Proficiencies to Excel in This Role)

  • Ability to communicate (speak/write) fluent English
  • 2 + yrs proven experience editing direct response performance creatives for paid social platforms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, etc.)
  • Must have AI video experience and samples to showcase your work
  • Strong understanding of conversion-focused editing, including hooks, pacing, storytelling, and call-to-action structure
  • Demonstrated ability to produce high-volume creative output in a fast-paced, test-and-learn environment
  • Hands-on experience using AI video generation and enhancement tools within production workflows
  • Proficiency with core editing platforms such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or equivalent
  • Working knowledge of creative design tools such as Canva, Photoshop, or Figma
  • Experience collaborating closely with creative strategists, growth teams, or performance marketing teams
  • Ability to interpret creative briefs and execute with minimal revision cycles
  • Strong communication skills and comfort participating in real-time feedback sessions
  • Ability to manage multiple creative experiments simultaneously while maintaining speed and quality

AI & Technical Proficiency (Required)

  • Experience working with tools such as Higgsfield, Google V3/Gemini workflows , or similar AI-driven platforms
  • Understanding of AI-assisted editing techniques, including both overt AI creative and realistic AI integrations

Nice-to-Have Proficiencies

  • Experience with advanced AI platforms such as Sora, Kling , or emerging generative video tools
  • Familiarity with open-source AI workflows or technical experimentation across AI ecosystems
  • Background supporting or coordinating external video editors or creative contractors

Additional Requirements

  • Willingness to work within US time zones (Eastern preferred)
  • Access to a work computer, a reliable internet connection and a distraction-free workspace
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response and AI-enhanced video work


Offer Details

Compensation: Contractor compensation will be aligned to regional market benchmarks based on the candidate’s country of residence and expressed as monthly salary ranges.


About Organics Ocean

To learn the founder’s story and more about Organics Ocean, visit the website.

The company is a place for innovation. Team roles and responsibilities are clear, and the passion for being a part of something bigger than oneself is shared by everyone. The environment is casual, but the work is serious. Riding this wave of growth only works with A-Players on the team, and that is what everyone is: an A-Player.


Cultural Pillars:

  • Accountability : Take full ownership of your responsibilities and their outcomes. You commit to seeing tasks through, accepting both successes and failures as your own, and continuously learning and improving along the way.
  • Operational Excellence: We believe a strong Foundation is a scalable business. In e-commerce, every action becomes a building block and small cracks compound quickly as we grow. We prioritize building reliable processes, systems, and standards that hold up under scale. We fix breakdowns early, design for consistency, and execute with discipline so growth doesn't introduce chaos.
  • Clarity & Trust: Clarity builds trust, and it goes both ways. Leaders are responsible for setting clear expectations, priorities, and context. Team members are responsible for asking questions, raising their hands, and seeking clarity when something is unclear. When clarity is actively given an actively sought, trust grows, decisions improve, and the teams move faster together.
  • Efficient Leverage: Efficient leverage means doing the right work, not more work. We challenge the status quo, explore better ways of working, and speak up when we see opportunities to improve. We value fresh thinking, but apply it with intention, building systems, making decisions, and creating leverage that drives meaningful impact. Through innovation paired with discipline, we pull the right levers to move the business forward and scale sustainably.
  • Move Fast and Persevere: We push forward with speed and determination, even when things get tough. In the fast-paced world of e-commerce and startups, challenges are inevitable. Success comes from acting quickly, adapting, and staying resilient when obstacles arise. We don’t slow down when things get hard—we press through and keep moving forward.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Desenvolvedor Java
description:
Cód. 58141


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Java Backend + Spring avançado (Spring Boot, Data, Cache, MVC, Security etc.)
  • AWS na prática (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudFormation e afins)
  • Arquitetura moderna : microsserviços, mensageria (Kafka/SQS) e containers (Docker)
  • Bancos de dados : relacionais (SQL/Aurora/Redshift/PostgreSQL) e não relacionais (BigQuery/Firestore/MongoDB/ElasticSearch)

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

title: Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

“Estamos buscando um Engenheiro Sênior de Automação de Mainframe experiente para liderar a migração e otimização de soluções de automação em mainframe. Esta função tem como foco a transição do CA OPS/MVS para o IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e do CA Automation Point para o IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) .

O candidato ideal terá um papel crítico para garantir a eficiência operacional, a disponibilidade dos sistemas e processos de automação contínuos em um ambiente z/OS complexo.

Você irá colaborar de perto com a equipe de Automação para implementar soluções de automação baseadas em políticas, reduzir a sobrecarga administrativa e aumentar a capacidade de resposta dos sistemas. Esta posição não impacta o desenvolvimento de aplicações, mas influencia significativamente as estratégias e operações de automação.”


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar projetos de migração de CA OPS/MVS para IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e de CA Automation Point para IBM SAIOM.
  • Configurar e implementar soluções IBM Systems Automation, incluindo automação baseada em políticas para ambientes z/OS.
  • Desenvolver e manter regras de automação, execs REXX e configurações do System Automation Policy Database (PDB) .
  • Prestar suporte na instalação e configuração de produtos de automação da IBM.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de operações para otimizar processos de inicialização, desligamento e recuperação dos sistemas.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade e eficiência dos sistemas críticos por meio de estratégias proativas de automação.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e etapas de migração, garantindo comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados à automação em ambientes de produção.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • Experiência em Operações de Mainframe: Mínimo de 5+ anos em ambiente de operações de mainframe, em funções operacionais, de serviços, consultoria ou suporte.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Conhecimento avançado e experiência prática.
  • CA OPS/MVS: Avançado.
  • TSO e ISPF: Proficiência no uso dessas ferramentas para gerenciamento de sistemas.
  • JCL: Fortes habilidades em Job Control Language.
  • Programação REXX: Capacidade de escrever e manter scripts REXX.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Conhecimento prático obrigatório.
  • Experiência em Migração: Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de automação em z/OS.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experiência na implementação e utilização deste produto.
  • Scripting REXX: Avançado.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • Conhecimento de outros softwares IBM Z, incluindo operação, configuração e automação de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com processos de inicialização e desligamento do sistema z/OS.
  • Experiência com SMP/E para instalação e manutenção de software.
  • Entendimento de produtos de automação concorrentes no ecossistema de mainframe.
  • Especialização em configurações de sistemas totalmente automatizados em IBM Z.

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
SOBRE A LETS


A LETS é uma empresa de tecnologia que atua na integração de canais de venda com operadores logísticos, potencializando resultados de negócios por meio de soluções inovadoras.   • Construir pipelines de ingestão e transformação de dados usando Kestra, DBT, Python e Athena;
  • Modelar e manter dados em Apache Iceberg com controle de versionamento, time travel e performance analítica;
  • Integrar fontes diversas (bancos, APIs, arquivos, etc.) com foco em rastreabilidade e escalabilidade;
  • Criar e manter modelos transformacionais com DBT, preparando datasets confiáveis e auditáveis;
  • Participar de integrações de dados com fluxos de IA/MCP, colaborando com cientistas e analistas;
  • Desenvolver dashboards com QuickSight, Metabase (ou ferramentas similares) com foco em usabilidade e performance;
  • Atuar em decisões de arquitetura, boas práticas de dados e melhoria contínua dos pipelines;
  • Contribuir para a construção de uma base de conhecimento, registrando soluções frequentes e otimizações para o uso futuro;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com outras áreas, como produto e operações, para garantir que feedbacks dos clientes sejam levados em consideração.


REQUISITOS:

  • Experiência com AWS Athena e estruturas de dados em S3;
  • Domínio de Apache Iceberg ou formatos semelhantes (Delta Lake, Hudi);
  • Vivência com ferramentas de orquestração como Kestra (ou equivalentes como Airflow, Prefect);
  • Conhecimento prático em DBT e versionamento de modelos analíticos;
  • Forte domínio de Python para automações, integrações e manipulação de dados;
  • Noções de Inteligência Artificial e Modelos Cognitivos de Processamento (MCP);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI como QuickSight, Metabase ou similares de nível compatível.
  • Conhecimentos aprofundados em SQL;
  • Conhecimentos em ferramentas de IA e desenvolvimento de prompts adaptáveis;


HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS:

  • Ensino Superior em Curso nas áreas de Engenharia, Ciências da Computação/Dados, Estatística ou correlatas;
  • Experiência anterior com produtos de tecnologia ou SaaS com ênfase em dados e BI;
  • Experiência prévia com de BI;
  • Conhecimento básico de sistemas logísticos ou de e-commerce será um diferencial.


BENEFÍCIOS:

  • Remuneração competitiva + participação nos resultados .
  • Plano de saúde (incluindo cônjuge e filhos).
  • Licença Remunerada Anual
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternindade
  • Plano odontológico .
  • Seguro de vida .
  • Cartão de benefícios flexível .
  • Day Off de Aniversário.
  • Rotina com ferramentas modernas e IA ; aprendizado contínuo.
  • 100% remoto (trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil).


DETALHES:

  • Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) .
  • Jornada: tempo integral, com eventuais rituais/treinamentos.
  • Local: remoto – fuso BRT (GMT-3) .
  • Todas as vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD).
  • Em nossos processos seletivos, não há qualquer tipo de distinção em virtude de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, crença, condição social, etnia ou raça .


COMO SE DESTACAR:

Ao se candidatar, envie portfólio, GitHub, dashboards ou cases (mesmo acadêmicos/pessoais) que mostrem, na prática:

  • Construção de pipelines de dados de ponta a ponta (ingestão, transformação, modelagem e consumo).
  • Seu raciocínio técnico nas escolhas de arquitetura, ferramentas e estruturação dos dados.
  • Exemplos de modelagem, SQL, Python e uso de ferramentas como DBT, Athena , orquestradores ou similares.
  • Dashboards e análises com foco em decisão, usabilidade e contexto de negócio.
  • Cuidados com qualidade, rastreabilidade, documentação e manutenção dos pipelines.
  • Casos de integração com APIs, bancos, arquivos ou automações.
  • Como você aprende , evolui tecnicamente e incorpora feedback no dia a dia.

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Senior Business/System Analyst (Disaster Recovery)
description:
Product Overview:

Vuori is re-defining what athletic apparel looks like: built to move and sweat in but designed with a casual aesthetic to transition into everyday life. Our high-energy, fast-paced office environment is reflected in the clothes we make. We aim to inspire others to take on all aspects of their lives with clarity, enthusiasm, and purpose…. while having a lot of fun along the way. Overview

We are seeking a contract Business Analyst to support the development and execution of our Disaster Recovery (DR) Program. This role will help establish structure, documentation, and repeatable processes to ensure our DR efforts are organized, testable, and aligned with business needs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop the overall structure and framework for the Disaster Recovery Program, including roles, responsibilities, and governance.

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Program Coordinator, or similar role.

  • Strong communication and documentation skills with the ability to translate complex technical inputs into clear, structured outputs.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with infrastructure, applications, and security teams.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Confluence, Jira, Microsoft 365, and diagramming solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure, SaaS vendor DR models, or hybrid cloud environments.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Clinical Statistical Programmer (SAS / CDISC)
description:
Job Title: Clinical Statistical Programmer (SAS / CDISC)

Location - Brazil


Role Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented Clinical Statistical Programmer to support clinical trial data standardization, analysis, and regulatory submissions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in CDISC standards (SDTM & ADaM), SAS programming, and generation of Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs), along with experience in quality control and submission readiness.

Key Responsibilities

· Transform raw clinical trial data into CDISC-compliant SDTM and ADaM datasets

· Develop, validate, and maintain Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs) for clinical study reports and regulatory submissions

· Write efficient, well-documented SAS programs for data cleaning, derivations, and reporting

· Develop reusable Python or R scripts for automation, validation, and reproducible reporting

· Perform programming QC and peer reviews to ensure accuracy and traceability

· Prepare and maintain programming specifications, mapping documents, and annotated


CRFs

· Troubleshoot complex data integration and derivation issues

· Support audits and regulatory inspections with reproducible code and documentation


Required Qualifications

· Strong experience with SAS programming

· Hands-on experience with CDISC standards (SDTM & ADaM)

· Experience generating TLFs for regulatory submissions

· Knowledge of clinical trial data structures and submission processes

· Familiarity with Python or R for automation (preferred)

· Strong attention to detail and documentation practices


Preferred

· Experience supporting FDA/EMA regulatory submissions

· Prior experience in a Pharma, Biotech, or CRO environment

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Systems Engineer to work for our client. The ideal candidate aligns with the responsibilities and qualifications outlined below.


If you’re a systems expert who thrives in cloud‑driven, enterprise environments and you want a fully remote role with real technical ownership, this opportunity will give you the autonomy, complexity, and impact you’re looking for.


About the Role

Our client is seeking a skilled Systems Engineer with strong experience in virtualization, directory services, cloud environments, and enterprise server administration. In this role, you’ll support and optimize core infrastructure, improve system reliability, modernize environments, and play a critical part in supporting global teams.


This is the perfect position for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and working with a modern Microsoft‑centered stack.


What You’ll Do

  • Manage and optimize VMware environments, including configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting
  • Administer Active Directory, Azure Active Directory, identity management, and group policy
  • Support and maintain Windows Server environments across production and staging platforms
  • Implement and manage Azure cloud services, virtual machines, and hybrid integrations
  • Monitor system performance and ensure high availability of critical infrastructure
  • Lead incident resolution, root cause analysis, and remediation efforts
  • Support infrastructure automation, documentation, and best‑practice improvements
  • Collaborate with global IT teams to implement system upgrades, patches, and enhancements
  • Maintain security standards and ensure compliance across systems and environments


What You Bring

  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required
  • 5+ years of Systems Engineering experience
  • Strong hands‑on experience with VMware virtualization
  • Advanced knowledge of Active Directory administration
  • Experience managing and maintaining Windows Server environments
  • Working knowledge of Azure infrastructure and cloud services
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, firewalls, routing preferred)
  • Experience troubleshooting complex enterprise infrastructure issues
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work cross‑functionally in a remote environment
  • Ability to manage priorities and self‑direct in a distributed team structure


What Our Client Offers

  • Fully remote role based in Brazil with global team collaboration
  • Opportunity to work with modern virtualization and cloud infrastructure
  • High‑impact systems ownership with strong visibility across IT leadership
  • Professional development, cloud learning resources, and certification support
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and long‑term growth opportunities
  • A collaborative, engineering‑minded culture that values innovation and continuous improvement

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst | Tableau
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce and technology solutions provider delivering innovative, data-driven services to enterprise clients worldwide. We combine deep technical expertise with strong business acumen to help organizations modernize systems, optimize performance, and unlock the value of their data. Our teams partner closely with stakeholders to translate complex business needs into scalable, impactful solutions. At Pinnacle Group, we foster collaboration, continuous learning, and measurable results.


Summary

We are seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst | Tableau who will serve as both a functional and technical partner to the business. This role is responsible for gathering requirements, defining KPIs, and designing robust Tableau dashboards using advanced calculations and Level of Detail (LOD) expressions. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, business-focused, and capable of building scalable reporting solutions from scratch. This position requires strong stakeholder engagement skills and deep expertise in Tableau development.


Job Description

  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather and document reporting requirements, define success metrics, and establish actionable KPIs.
  • Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end Tableau dashboards from scratch using complex calculations and advanced LOD expressions.
  • Translate business questions into scalable data models, visualizations, and performance-driven analytics solutions.
  • Create calculated fields, parameters, filters, and data blending solutions to support dynamic reporting needs.
  • Perform data validation, quality checks, and reconciliation to ensure accuracy and consistency of insights.
  • Optimize dashboard performance through efficient data modeling and query tuning.
  • Present findings and insights to business leaders, translating technical outputs into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Continuously enhance reporting frameworks by identifying automation opportunities and implementing best practices in BI development.


Requirements

  • 3–5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence or Data Analytics with strong Tableau development expertise.
  • Demonstrated experience creating dashboards from scratch using complex calculations and LOD expressions.
  • Proven ability to gather business requirements and translate them into measurable KPIs and reporting solutions.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases and large datasets.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts and performance optimization techniques.
  • Ability to balance technical execution with business-facing communication and stakeholder management.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will work on high-impact initiatives that directly influence business strategy and decision-making. We empower our employees to take ownership of their work while providing the support and resources needed for professional growth. Our collaborative environment encourages innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning. Joining our team means contributing to meaningful data-driven transformation while advancing your career in a dynamic, forward-thinking organization.


Instructions

Please answer the questions below, attach your resume and email your responses to the correct contacts as part of your application. Please email your resume and responses to: and .


  • Describe your experience building Tableau dashboards from scratch, including how many you have created, examples of complex calculations, LOD expressions you have implemented.
  • How do you approach gathering business requirements and translating them into measurable KPIs?
  • Please share anything else you would like us to know that highlights your strengths or sets you apart as a Business Intelligence Analyst specialized in Tableau dashboard creation.

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.
