Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site and remote/hybrid work environments .
  • Budget & Risk Management: Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively; implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.g., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs.
  • Quality Assurance & Delivery: Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.g., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs.
  • Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement: Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emerging industry trends (like AI integration in project management , DevSecOps , and new collaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Professional Knowledge: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding of IT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentals to effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices.
  • Project Management Skills: Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects using project management methodologies (Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes.
  • Leadership & Communication: Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams , managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced Knowledge: Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such as cloud computing projects, digital transformation , or AI-driven solutions is a plus.
  • Industry Experience: Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment , managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background in network/security infrastructure projects or software development projects is advantageous.
  • Methodologies: Certifications or hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) or DevOps/DevSecOps practices.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managing multiple full project lifecycles , with at least several projects related to IT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure . Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential.

Certifications:

  • Project Management Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 (highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise.
  • Security/Technical Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) , Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) , or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance.
  • Agile/Other Certs: Additional certifications like Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or ITIL Foundation are beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products

This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

title: iOS Engineer (Swift)
description:
Salary: 55 LPA INR


Position Overview – Senior iOS Engineer

We are seeking experienced iOS engineers who enjoy working closely with cross‑functional teams and who bring strong architectural thinking, product sensibility, and a deep understanding of modern iOS development.

This role involves supporting a large and diverse user base, evolving the mobile application with new features, and ensuring high performance and quality across devices.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to plan, design, and deliver new application features.
  • Work together with backend/API developers and other mobile engineers to maintain a scalable, reliable, and well‑structured app ecosystem.
  • Continuously explore new iOS technologies and propose improvements to enhance product quality and user experience.
  • Participate in code reviews, refine development processes, and contribute to technical decision‑making.
  • Improve workflows, documentation, and collaboration practices within the engineering team.
  • Stay current with iOS platform changes and apply best practices to ongoing development.

Mandatory Requirements

  • B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 6+ years of iOS development experience using Swift .
  • Minimum 1 year of hands‑on development using SwiftUI .
  • Deep understanding of modern iOS features and platform best practices.
  • Experience working with mid‑complexity mobile architectures (e.g., MVVM , VIPER , Clean Architecture , etc.).
  • Experience with mobile CI/CD platforms such as Bitrise or Jenkins.
  • Solid understanding of software design principles (e.g., SOLID , design patterns).
  • Familiarity with automated mobile testing (Unit, UI, Smoke Testing, etc.).
  • Strong communication skills, empathy, and a collaborative mindset.
  • Motivated to work in a team‑based product environment.
  • Strong sense of UX, attention to detail, and focus on usability.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with reactive programming frameworks.
  • Familiarity with test-driven development (TDD) or behavior-driven development (BDD).
  • Knowledge of performance profiling, debugging, and optimization on iOS.
  • Ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation and guidelines.
  • Experience in travel‑related products or services.

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Auditors of Certificates of Insurance


HOW THIS POSITION HELPS JONES SUCCEED

As an Auditor of Certificates of Insurance (COI) you will be responsible for verifying that the documents provided by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors in our platform have the necessary coverage required by our customers.


All the necessary training to perform the necessary tasks will be offered.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The high-level goal for this role is to help the company to deliver accurate audit resolutions in a timely manner.


  • This role demands a high level of commitment and dedication; this is a full-time, hands-on position requiring 40 hours per week, with occasional after-hours work as needed (including additional compensation).
  • This is not a role for someone seeking a casual or part-time opportunity; it demands undivided attention and cannot be reconciled with concurrent employment commitments


Be prepared for a fast-paced environment and to seek process improvements and personal development actively.


WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT

  • Be detail-oriented. High level of thoroughness, accuracy, organization, and productivity;
  • Communicate fluently in English (advanced written skills);
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week during American business hoursç
  • Eager to learn and keen on coaching and feedback;
  • Open to failure and rejection in the spirit of learning, progress, and resilienceç
  • Ability to demonstrate a level of success in executing a repeatable operation methodologyç
  • Must be self-motivated, persistent, and able to work independently.


WHAT MAKES THIS JOB A GREAT OPPORTUNITY

  • Build subject-matter expertise in an area of real estate operations and insurance that is lucrative and is undergoing serious digital transformation;
  • Fair compensation with pay raises and bonuses;
  • Mentorship from talented leaders;
  • Be part of an award-winning company that is tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month;
  • Be part of a lean and agile team, with a strong culture;
  • Help Jones execute a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world;
  • Gain a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.



OUR CULTURE

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their roles and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward.


Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:


  • We get things done, period, full stop
  • We give help generously
  • We fall in love with customer problems
  • We feel the pain, then we fix the process
  • We build trust everywhere
  • We take care of ourselves with rest, time away from work and simply having fun



ABOUT JONES

Jones helps real estate and construction firms to remove the barrier of insurance compliance through one software application that integrates with core operating systems. We envision a world where every property and construction site is connected by a network of insurance data enabling individuals to find, check and verify compliance instantly. Over 1 billion square feet of real estate relies on Jones daily, including firms such as Empire State Realty, Tishman Speyer, JLL, Rudin Management, and many more.


We have headquarters in New York, NY, and Tel Aviv, Israel. Our team spans 16 countries. Brazil's crew is expanding fast, fully remote, with annual in-person gatherings.

title: Visual & Brand Experience Designer
description:
Visual & Brand Experience Designer


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform. This role will play a key part in reimagining how customers navigate and interact with a multi-brand digital ecosystem.


You will lead the Visual Makeover & Usability workstream while also helping shape a multi-brand gallery experience that brings together multiple brands within a single marketplace environment. The ideal candidate is a highly creative product designer who can quickly move from research and benchmarking into compelling visual concepts that inspire stakeholders and guide product direction.


This is a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles, so comfort working in ambiguous environments and presenting bold ideas to senior stakeholders is essential.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and lead the visual direction for key product workstreams focused on improving usability and modernizing the marketplace interface.
  • Conduct benchmarking of leading global marketplace platforms to inform design strategy and identify best-in-class user experience patterns.
  • Develop high-fidelity visual concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate new interface directions and inspire product leadership.
  • Design and prototype a multi-brand navigation and discovery experience that enables users to seamlessly browse across brands within a unified marketplace.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate design ideas into clear product directions.
  • Present design concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders, helping guide decision-making around product experience and visual identity.
  • Work within a fast-moving consulting team delivering iterative design outputs across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design, visual design, or UI design
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality interface design and visual storytelling
  • Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns
  • Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products
  • Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas
  • Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments with rapid iteration cycles


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing multi-brand digital ecosystems or marketplaces
  • Familiarity with Asian marketplace and super-app UX paradigms such as those seen in Alibaba, Shopee, or Pinduoduo
  • Background working with retail, consumer products, or marketplace platforms
  • Previous experience in agency or consulting environments with fast delivery timelines


If you’re a designer who enjoys pushing visual boundaries, exploring global product patterns, and shaping the experience of large-scale digital platforms, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-visibility product initiative.

Sobre a vaga

Estamos buscando um Desenvolvedor React Native que não apenas construa interfaces, mas que entenda como integrar Inteligência Artificial no core do produto. O candidato ideal é um engenheiro \"AI-First\", que utiliza ferramentas como Cursor para acelerar o desenvolvimento e possui conhecimento profundo sobre como orquestrar Agentes de IA e gerenciar contexto via MCP (Model Context Protocol).

Você trabalhará diretamente com Spec-Driven Development (SDD), transformando PRDs (Product Requirement Documents) em especificações técnicas precisas que alimentam fluxos de codificação assistida por IA.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento Mobile: Arquitetar e desenvolver aplicações escaláveis em React Native (iOS/Android) com TypeScript.
  • Integração de IA: Implementar funcionalidades que consomem LLMs, gerenciam estado de conversação e integram ferramentas externas via MCP.
  • Fluxo AI-First: Utilizar o editor Cursor como IDE principal, dominando a composição de contextos, regras de projeto (.cursorrules) e automação de refatoração.
  • Engenharia de Especificação: Atuar no modelo Spec-Driven Development (SDD). Ler o PRD, criar/refinar a Spec técnica e garantir que a implementação siga estritamente o contrato definido, utilizando IA para geração e validação de código.
  • Agentes Autônomos: Desenvolver ou integrar \"Agent Skills\" dentro do app, permitindo que o usuário interaja com agentes capazes de executar tarefas complexas (ex: buscar dados, agendar, analisar).
  • Qualidade: Garantir performance, acessibilidade e testes automatizados, validando o código gerado por IA.


Requisitos

  • React Native: Domínio avançado (Hooks, Performance, Native Modules, Reanimated).
  • TypeScript: Tipagem estrita e avançada.
  • Ecossistema de IA: Experiência prática com Cursor IDE (Composer, Chat, Rules).
  • Conhecimento de MCP (Model Context Protocol) para conexão de dados e ferramentas.
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de AI Agents e Orquestração (LangChain, Vercel AI SDK ou similar).
  • Metodologia: Vivência com Spec-Driven Development ou trabalho orientado a contratos de interface/API.
  • Produto: Capacidade de ler e questionar PRDs, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em especificações técnicas.

title: Archer System Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Estamos em busca de um(a) System Engineer Sênior com experiência em ARCHER e ambientes Cloud (Azure e AWS) , para atuar no planejamento, engenharia e sustentação da infraestrutura de sistemas da organização.

O(a) profissional será responsável por upgrades, versionamentos, rotinas de manutenção e por garantir a estabilidade, performance e evolução dos ambientes tecnológicos.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar como Archer IT Controls Engineer dentro do modelo de governança de risk management.
  • Realizar manutenções, ajustes e criação de novos módulos dentro da plataforma Archer.
  • Colaborar com equipes internas de tecnologia e governança.
  • Trabalhar com alto nível de autonomia e organização.
  • Atuar em ambientes cloud (principalmente AWS) e apoiar rotinas de infraestrutura.


O que você precisa ter

  • Conhecimento avançado em RSA Archer (criação, customização e manutenção de módulos).
  • Forte background de infraestrutura .
  • AWS – indispensável (principal ambiente utilizado).
  • Azure – conhecimento desejável .

  • Vivência com upgrades, versionamento e rotinas de manutenção.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimento em SQL e bancos de dados.
  • Experiência com ferramentas corporativas (Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Power BI ).
  • Familiaridade com práticas de desenvolvimento e CI/CD (GitHub, PowerShell, JavaScript, .NET ) e com gestão de mudanças (ITIL) .

title: Junior Data Engineer – Azure Databricks / Python / Spark
description:
Role: Data Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term (Through Dec 2026)

Work Schedule : 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: 8am - 5pm CST

Location : 100% Remote


We are seeking a Junior Data Engineer with experience in Azure Databricks, Python, and Apache Spark to build and maintain scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions. The role involves developing ETL/ELT pipelines, optimizing data processing, and supporting cloud-based data platforms in an Azure environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks and Azure Data Factory
  • Build and optimize Apache Spark jobs for large-scale data processing
  • Work with Python and SQL to transform and analyze data
  • Support data architecture using Delta Lake and Azure Data Lake Storage
  • Collaborate with product owners and analytics teams to deliver reliable data solutions

title: Marketing & Product Designer
description:
As a Marketing-Focused Visual & UI Designer at ProjectMark, you will help shape how our brand and product story show up across customer communications, our Help Center, and educational content like tutorials and feature walkthroughs. This role is heavily focused on improving the experience for our current client base by making information clearer, more consistent, and easier to access. You will also contribute to growth marketing efforts, including campaigns, paid ads, and website experiences.

We’re looking for someone who is tech-forward and curious by default, constantly exploring more efficient ways to work and leveraging modern, bleeding-edge tools (including new design, automation, and AI capabilities) to increase output quality and speed. While you will support product design (UX/UI) when needed, your primary goal is to partner with Marketing and Customer Success to improve acquisition, adoption, and retention through clear messaging, strong educational content, and high-quality design execution. You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product Design, Sales, and Engineering to turn ideas into polished assets and experiences that support both business goals and customer needs.


Key Responsibilities


Customer Communication & Lifecycle Assets

  • Design visuals and templates for customer emails, in-app announcements, release notes, webinars, and product updates.
  • Create on-brand resources that improve clarity and consistency across customer touchpoints.


Help Center & Education Content

  • Improve the Help Center experience through visual guidelines, layouts, illustrations, and content structure.
  • Create reusable article templates, diagrams, feature walkthroughs, and lightweight UI visuals that make documentation easier to scan and understand.
  • Partner with Customer Success to prioritize content based on support insights and feature releases.


Marketing & Growth Design 

  • Create and iterate on assets for paid ads, social media, email/newsletters, blog visuals, landing pages, and campaign materials.
  • Partner with Marketing to concept and execute campaigns, ensuring consistent brand quality across channels.
  • Support A/B testing and experimentation by producing variants quickly and consistently.


Website & Conversion Optimization

  • Collaborate with Marketing and Product to improve website structure, messaging hierarchy, and visual design to increase conversions.
  • Review analytics, heatmaps, and session replays to identify friction points and propose design improvements.
  • Design or refine landing pages and key website sections, keeping accessibility and performance in mind.


Sales & Operations Enablement 

  • Create and maintain sales enablement materials such as pitch decks, one-pagers, product sheets, case studies, and pricing visuals.
  • Design assets for events, webinars, internal presentations, and leadership updates as needed.


Product Design Support

  • Support the product design team with UI execution when needed, including new screens, flows, and improvements.
  • Help maintain and evolve the Design System to ensure brand and UI consistency across product and marketing surfaces.


Asset Management & Brand Consistency

  • Maintain an organized, scalable asset library (campaigns, templates, sectors, use cases).
  • Help refine and document brand guidelines and visual standards so execution stays consistent across the team.


What We’re Looking For


  • Strong experience in visual design with a portfolio that includes marketing assets (ads, landing pages, email, brand systems) and digital product/UI work.
  • Proven ability to design for clarity and adoption, creating resources that help customers understand, trust, and use the product.
  • High proficiency in Figma and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (or equivalent tools).
  • Solid understanding of typography, layout, hierarchy, and brand consistency across multiple channels.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Tech-forward mindset: actively explores new tools, workflows, and bleeding-edge technology to work smarter, improve speed/quality, and continuously optimize how the team designs and delivers work.
  • Advanced or fluent English communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience designing within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Familiarity with basic UX principles and designing within design systems.


Nice-to-Have Skills


  • Familiarity with performance marketing concepts (creative testing, funnels, conversion-focused design).
  • Experience with HubSpot (emails, templates, workflows).
  • Motion or video editing skills (short product demos, social video, feature highlight clips).
  • Copy sensibility (Ability to contribute to marketing and product copy, helping draft and refine messaging for ads, landing pages, emails, and in-app/customer communications.).


Submitting your resume and portfolio in English is preferred.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Enfermagem
description:
Quem somos


A Clínica Nuamse foi fundada em 2018 com o objetivo de atender um público que buscava excelência em estética, com atendimento exclusivo e personalizado.


Em 2023, a Dra. Cláudia Guimarães e o Dr. Fellipe Guimarães assumiram a gestão da clínica com uma nova visão: utilizar a medicina como ferramenta para melhorar a qualidade de vida dos pacientes por meio de um olhar humano, integrativo e centrado no bem-estar.


Após um processo de rebranding, a Nuamse passou a oferecer uma abordagem integral e personalizada à saúde, consolidando sua identidade como uma clínica de medicina integrativa de alto padrão.


A ampliação da proposta trouxe novos serviços voltados para:


  • Bem-estar
  • Longevidade
  • Performance e saúde preventiva


Hoje, a clínica conta com atendimentos especializados em:

  • Nutrologia
  • Nutrição
  • Dermatologia
  • Ginecologia
  • Endocrinologia
  • Pediatria


Com 6 anos de história, a Nuamse busca ser referência pela excelência no cuidado e por transformar a jornada de saúde de seus pacientes em uma experiência única e significativa.

Essa construção só foi possível com pessoas que também abraçaram esse propósito e contribuíram para a estrutura atual da clínica.


Este documento tem como objetivo esclarecer as principais funções e responsabilidades dos cargos da equipe, auxiliando no alinhamento das expectativas e no funcionamento eficiente da clínica.

Importante destacar que este descritivo não substitui os contratos firmados, servindo apenas como referência complementar para as atribuições de cada função.


Enfermeira de Clínica Médica


Descrição Geral

Profissional responsável pela assistência ao paciente, execução de procedimentos terapêuticos e suporte ao corpo clínico, garantindo a aplicação dos protocolos de qualidade e segurança na realização de triagens, exames e intervenções.


⏰ Carga horária: 20h semanais 

Salário: R$ 2.473,18


Principais Responsabilidades


Triagem, pré-atendimento e exames

  • Recepcionar pacientes e realizar triagem inicial.
  • Avaliar sinais vitais e medidas antropométricas.
  • Coletar informações relevantes de saúde, incluindo:
  • histórico clínico
  • hábitos de vida
  • medicamentos em uso
  • Realizar exames básicos como:
  • aferição de pressão arterial
  • glicemia capilar
  • bioimpedância
  • Registrar informações no prontuário eletrônico.
  • Orientar pacientes sobre os procedimentos a serem realizados.


Terapias Injetáveis e Infusões

  • Preparar e administrar medicamentos e terapias injetáveis conforme prescrição médica.
  • Garantir o correto manuseio e técnica de aplicação.
  • Monitorar pacientes durante e após os procedimentos.
  • Identificar e comunicar possíveis reações adversas ao médico responsável.


Apoio em Procedimentos Médicos

  • Preparar e organizar materiais e equipamentos necessários.
  • Garantir assepsia e condições adequadas durante os procedimentos.
  • Auxiliar médicos em:
  • implantes subcutâneos
  • curativos
  • procedimentos clínicos diversos

  • Implement deployment safety mechanisms such as environment protections, concurrency rules, and verification gates .
  • Operate and upgrade EKS clusters , including Karpenter provisioning, node groups, and critical cluster add-ons.

  • Automate repetitive tasks and maintain proactive runbooks to reduce operational risk.
  • Use AI tools to improve infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Collaborate with product teams to strengthen SLOs and deployment safety practices .
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure DevOps architectures .


Qualifications

  • Proven end-to-end ownership of production-grade Kubernetes/EKS environments including Karpenter and Atlantis-driven Terraform workflows.
  • Demonstrated expertise with ArgoCD GitOps patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with HashiCorp Vault, supply-chain security controls, and structured incident response including on-call rotations and post-incident reviews.
  • Active use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: AWS Data Engineer
description:
Senior AWS Data Engineer - Python, SQL, Airflow

Location: Remote

Contract: 3 months initial


We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer with a strong background in Quality Assurance to join our client's team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive data quality strategy as they migrate their SQL databases to AWS. Your expertise in Python, SQL, and ETL frameworks like Airflow and dbt will ensure high-quality data pipelines and effective diagnosis of pipeline failures.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Data Quality Strategy Development: Design and implement a robust data quality strategy that addresses current challenges in SQL to AWS migration, ensuring data integrity and reliability throughout the process.
  • Data Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough quality assessments, validate data transformations, and ensure that all data quality metrics are met. Focus on identifying gaps and areas for improvement within existing ETL workflows.
  • Technical Proficiency: Utilize Python and SQL for extracting, transforming, and loading data. Implement automated testing frameworks (pytest) to validate data integrity and functionality across pipelines.
  • ETL Management: Leverage tools like Airflow and dbt to orchestrate data workflows and conduct regular checks to ensure pipeline performance. Identify and troubleshoot sources of failures.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Manage data storage and processing on AWS platforms, specifically with Redshift and S3. Optimize data storage solutions and ensure best practices for data security and accessibility.
  • Root-Cause Analysis: Perform strong root-cause analysis to diagnose and resolve pipeline failures effectively. Document issues and fixes to improve future processes and communication with stakeholders.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including data scientists and business analysts, to continuously improve data processes and quality metrics. Communicate findings clearly and provide recommendations to enhance system performance.
  • Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation of data quality processes, testing outcomes, and any identified issues, along with their resolutions.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Proven experience as a Data Engineer, Data Analyst, or in a similar role with a focus on QA.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and experience with data pipeline tools such as Airflow and dbt.
  • Familiarity with AWS services, particularly Redshift and S3.
  • Excellent English speaking and communication skills, with experience presenting technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills with a keen ability to perform root-cause analysis and troubleshoot complex data issues.
  • Knowledge of data quality frameworks and methodologies is a plus.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados Sênior.


Imprescindível experiência em Arquitetura e construção de Data Lake.

Arquitetura de Data Lake: Planeja e desenvolve a arquitetura de Data Lake, levando em consideração escalabilidade, segurança, governança e integração com outras plataformas de análise de dados.


Gerenciamento de dados:

Organiza e classifica dados brutos (raw data) em zonas de armazenamento: camada bruta (raw zone), camada de enriquecimento (processed zone) e camada de dados preparados para análise (curated zone).

Conhecimento em gerenciamento de metadados, utilizando ferramentas como AWS Glue ou Apache Atlas.

Pipeline de Dados: Criação e automação de pipelines de dados para ingestão, processamento e armazenamento. Capacidade de lidar com dados em tempo real ou batch.

Qualidade e Governança de Dados: Implementação de políticas de governança de dados, incluindo controle de acesso, versionamento de dados e auditoria, usando ferramentas como Apache Ranger ou AWS Lake Formation.

Segurança de dados: Conhecimento em como garantir a segurança e privacidade dos dados, incluindo criptografia, autenticação e autorização adequadas, e conformidade com regulamentações como LGPD ou GDPR.


Domínio de ferramentas e tecnologias:


Plataformas de Data Lake como AWS (S3, Lake Formation), Azure (Data Lake Storage), Google Cloud (BigLake), Apache Hadoop e Apache Spark.

ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) e ELT com ferramentas como Apache NiFi, Talend, Apache Airflow, Fivetran ou dbt.

Armazenamento distribuído: Experiência com HDFS, S3 e Azure Blob Storage.

SQL e NoSQL: Capacidade de trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc.) e não-relacionais (MongoDB, Cassandra, etc.).

Linguagens de programação: Proeficiência em Python, Java, Scala, e até mesmo em R para manipulação de dados.

title: Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

O Clínica Experts é uma plataforma completa de gestão para clínicas de saúde, estética e bem-estar, utilizada diariamente por mais de 7.500 clínicas e 16.000 usuários. Entregamos soluções que integram agenda, prontuário, financeiro, estoque, comunicação omnichannel e inteligência artificial, garantindo eficiência e escala para operações de todos os portes.


Sobre a Oportunidade:

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para atuar diretamente no squad de IA do Clínica Experts, responsável por projetar, evoluir e escalar soluções baseadas em LLMs, agentes inteligentes e sistemas multi-agentes.

Você trabalhará em desafios reais de produção, com alto volume de dados e usuários, construindo soluções que vão desde engenharia de prompts até arquiteturas complexas de agentes com supervisão, memória, ferramentas e observabilidade.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Arquitetar e desenvolver soluções de IA baseadas em LLMs para ambientes de produção em larga escala;
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de agentes e multi-agentes, incluindo estruturas de supervisor, delegação de tarefas, memória e ferramentas;
  • Desenvolver fluxos complexos utilizando LangChain e LangGraph, aplicando boas práticas de composição, controle e observabilidade;
  • Integrar diferentes provedores de modelos (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, entre outros), escolhendo o melhor modelo para cada caso de uso;
  • Atuar na definição de estratégias de engenharia de prompt, avaliação de respostas, mitigação de alucinações e controle de qualidade;
  • Construir e evoluir pipelines de IA integrados a sistemas backend (APIs, filas, microsserviços);
  • Participar ativamente da inovação do produto através de POCs, MVPs e experimentos controlados;
  • Definir padrões técnicos, boas práticas e ajudar a elevar o nível do time, atuando como referência técnica em IA.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Fundamentos sólidos de IA aplicada e LLMs;
  • Engenharia de prompt (few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output, function calling);
  • LangChain e seus principais conceitos (chains, tools, memory, retrievers);
  • LangGraph para orquestração de fluxos e agentes complexos;
  • Arquiteturas de agentes autônomos e multi-agentes, incluindo supervisor/worker;
  • Integração com APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude);
  • Design de APIs e serviços backend para consumo de IA;
  • Observabilidade aplicada a IA (logs, métricas, tracing, avaliação de respostas);
  • Conceitos de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings e vetorização;
  • Mensageria, processamento assíncrono e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Experiência prática colocando soluções de IA em produção;
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, sendo parte disso com sistemas complexos ou distribuídos.


Você vai se divertir mais se:

  • Tiver paixão por inteligência artificial e acompanhar a evolução rápida do ecossistema de LLMs;
  • Gostar de resolver problemas ambíguos e ainda não totalmente definidos;
  • Curte equilibrar experimentação rápida com engenharia robusta para produção;
  • Tiver senso de dono e se preocupar com impacto real no usuário final.


Será um diferencial se você:

  • Tiver experiência com Node.js, Python ou TypeScript em sistemas de IA;
  • Já tiver trabalhado com RAG em produção, FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate ou similares;
  • Conhecer técnicas de avaliação automática de LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge, scoring, CSAT);
  • Possuir experiência com AWS (EC2, S3, filas, escalabilidade);
  • Ter participado da construção de produtos de IA para usuários finais;
  • Já ter atuado como referência técnica ou líder técnico.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

title: General Manager-Civil & Utilities Construction
description:
About the Company

The company is a privately held, nationally recognized utility contractor with more than 100 years of history. They are one of the few firms in the industry that fully self-performs all aspects of open-cut and specialty pipe rehabilitation.

The company operates across key U.S. markets including California, Maryland, and Washington, D.C. and are known for thier technical expertise, disciplined execution, strong safety culture, and long-standing client relationships across the public utility and infrastructure sectors.

About the Position

The General Manager (GM) serves as the senior leader for the company's California Region, with full P&L responsibility and accountability for all aspects of regional performance. This role is responsible for driving safety, operational excellence, financial results, talent development, client satisfaction, and strategic growth.

Reporting into corporate leadership, the SVP/GM acts as the primary executive representative for the region—aligning regional strategy with corporate objectives while building a high-performing, accountable leadership team. Success in this role requires strong business judgment, deep operational expertise in civil and utility construction, and the ability to lead complex organizations through growth.

Key Responsibilities

Regional & Business Leadership

  • Provide overall leadership, direction, and accountability for all regional operations and business functions
  • Develop and execute regional business plans aligned with corporate strategy and long-term growth objectives
  • Serve as the senior company representative with clients, partners, regulators, and internal stakeholders
  • Champion company culture, values, and a strong commitment to safety, ethics, and operational excellence

Operational Oversight

  • Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple civil and utility construction projects
  • Ensure projects meet standards for safety, quality, schedule, and profitability
  • Establish performance expectations and conduct regular operational and project reviews
  • Drive continuous improvement across operations, processes, and resource utilization

Financial Management & P&L Accountability

  • Maintain full responsibility for regional financial performance including revenue, margin, overhead, and cash flow
  • Review and approve budgets, forecasts, and financial plans
  • Analyze financial results, identify risks and opportunities, and implement corrective actions
  • Prepare and present financial performance reports to senior leadership

Contract, Risk & Compliance Management

  • Ensure compliance with contractual, legal, and regulatory requirements
  • Oversee contract negotiations, change management, claims, and dispute resolution
  • Proactively identify and mitigate operational, financial, and contractual risks

Safety & Quality Leadership

  • Lead a safety-first culture and ensure compliance with OSHA, company, and client requirements
  • Hold leadership teams accountable for safety and quality outcomes
  • Promote continuous improvement in safety performance and execution quality

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop regional leadership including project managers, superintendents, and support teams
  • Support recruiting, onboarding, performance management, and succession planning
  • Build a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing regional organization
  • Encourage professional development and retention of top talent

Business Development & Client Relations

  • Drive regional growth through new market opportunities and expanded client relationships
  • Partner with business development teams on pursuit strategy, proposals, and interviews
  • Strengthen relationships with owners, utilities, subcontractors, vendors, and regulatory agencies
  • Ensure high levels of client satisfaction and repeat business

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Business, or related field (preferred)
  • Extensive senior leadership experience in civil and utility construction
  • Proven success leading a region or business unit with full P&L responsibility
  • Strong understanding of the California construction market and regulatory environment
  • Demonstrated financial expertise in budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and performance analysis
  • Ability to interpret construction drawings, specifications, and contract documents
  • Exceptional leadership, decision-making, and problem-solving skills
  • Strong executive-level communication and stakeholder management abilities
  • Willingness to travel and work extended hours as required
  • Highly organized, results-driven, and capable of managing complex, competing priorities

Benefits

  • Competitive executive-level compensation package
  • Performance-based incentives tied to regional results
  • Opportunity to lead a major region for a respected, privately held national contractor
  • Long-term career growth and influence within a stable, values-driven organization
  • Comprehensive benefits package

description:

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional.
  • Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual)
  • Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância.
  • Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados.
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.


Requisitos necessários

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch
  • Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância.
  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual).
  • Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank.
  • Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes.
  • Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery.
  • Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.


Perfil esperado

  • Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário.
  • Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto.
  • Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta.
  • Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados.
  • Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.

title: General Manager-Civil & Utilities Construction
description:
About the Company

The company is a privately held, nationally recognized utility contractor with more than 100 years of history. They are one of the few firms in the industry that fully self-performs all aspects of open-cut and specialty pipe rehabilitation.

The company operates across key U.S. markets including California, Maryland, and Washington, D.C. and are known for thier technical expertise, disciplined execution, strong safety culture, and long-standing client relationships across the public utility and infrastructure sectors.

About the Position

The General Manager (GM) serves as the senior leader for the company's California Region, with full P&L responsibility and accountability for all aspects of regional performance. This role is responsible for driving safety, operational excellence, financial results, talent development, client satisfaction, and strategic growth.

Reporting into corporate leadership, the SVP/GM acts as the primary executive representative for the region—aligning regional strategy with corporate objectives while building a high-performing, accountable leadership team. Success in this role requires strong business judgment, deep operational expertise in civil and utility construction, and the ability to lead complex organizations through growth.

Key Responsibilities

Regional & Business Leadership

  • Provide overall leadership, direction, and accountability for all regional operations and business functions
  • Develop and execute regional business plans aligned with corporate strategy and long-term growth objectives
  • Serve as the senior company representative with clients, partners, regulators, and internal stakeholders
  • Champion company culture, values, and a strong commitment to safety, ethics, and operational excellence

Operational Oversight

  • Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple civil and utility construction projects
  • Ensure projects meet standards for safety, quality, schedule, and profitability
  • Establish performance expectations and conduct regular operational and project reviews
  • Drive continuous improvement across operations, processes, and resource utilization

Financial Management & P&L Accountability

  • Maintain full responsibility for regional financial performance including revenue, margin, overhead, and cash flow
  • Review and approve budgets, forecasts, and financial plans
  • Analyze financial results, identify risks and opportunities, and implement corrective actions
  • Prepare and present financial performance reports to senior leadership

Contract, Risk & Compliance Management

  • Ensure compliance with contractual, legal, and regulatory requirements
  • Oversee contract negotiations, change management, claims, and dispute resolution
  • Proactively identify and mitigate operational, financial, and contractual risks

Safety & Quality Leadership

  • Lead a safety-first culture and ensure compliance with OSHA, company, and client requirements
  • Hold leadership teams accountable for safety and quality outcomes
  • Promote continuous improvement in safety performance and execution quality

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop regional leadership including project managers, superintendents, and support teams
  • Support recruiting, onboarding, performance management, and succession planning
  • Build a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing regional organization
  • Encourage professional development and retention of top talent

Business Development & Client Relations

  • Drive regional growth through new market opportunities and expanded client relationships
  • Partner with business development teams on pursuit strategy, proposals, and interviews
  • Strengthen relationships with owners, utilities, subcontractors, vendors, and regulatory agencies
  • Ensure high levels of client satisfaction and repeat business

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Business, or related field (preferred)
  • Extensive senior leadership experience in civil and utility construction
  • Proven success leading a region or business unit with full P&L responsibility
  • Strong understanding of the California construction market and regulatory environment
  • Demonstrated financial expertise in budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and performance analysis
  • Ability to interpret construction drawings, specifications, and contract documents
  • Exceptional leadership, decision-making, and problem-solving skills
  • Strong executive-level communication and stakeholder management abilities
  • Willingness to travel and work extended hours as required
  • Highly organized, results-driven, and capable of managing complex, competing priorities

Benefits

  • Competitive executive-level compensation package
  • Performance-based incentives tied to regional results
  • Opportunity to lead a major region for a respected, privately held national contractor
  • Long-term career growth and influence within a stable, values-driven organization
  • Comprehensive benefits package

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

title: Pessoa engenheira de gestão de ativos
description:
No mundo, a ENGIE é um importante player na transição energética, com o propósito de acelerar jornada rumo a uma economia neutra em carbono. Presente em 30 países e com 98 mil colaboradores, o Grupo atua em toda a cadeia de valor da energia, da geração renovável e gás verde à infraestrutura e fornecimento.
No Brasil, a ENGIE , empresa líder em energia 100% renovável do país, atua em geração, comercialização e transmissão de energia elétrica, Operação, manutenção e transporte de gás , e soluções energéticas. A empresa possui cerca de 13 GW de capacidade instalada, provenientes de fontes renováveis e com baixas emissões de Gases de Efeito Estufa (GEE), como usinas hidrelétricas, eólicas, solares e a biomassa.
A ENGIE Serviços de Operação e Manutenção é responsável por operar e manter os gasodutos da TAG, empresa adquirida pelo grupo em 2020. Com a aquisição da TAG , a ENGIE é detentora da mais extensa malha de transporte de gás natural do país com 4.500 km que atravessam 10 estados e 191 municípios.
Missão do Cargo
Atuar de forma estratégica e técnica na gestão do ciclo de vida dos ativos do gasoduto, garantindo sua integridade, confiabilidade e desempenho, por meio da aplicação integradade soluções de engenharia nas disciplinas de medição, automação, elétrica, equipamentos rotativos, compressores, proteção catódica, geotecnia e engenharia de integridade.
Assegurar a disponibilidade operacional, o cumprimento das normas técnicas e regulatórias, e o alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio, promovendo uma abordagem preventiva
e sustentável.
Responsabilidades Principais
Executar e apoiar tecnicamente as inspeções e avaliações de integridade dos equipamentos e dutos, realizando acompanhamento de campo, controle de relatórios e registros
técnicos, e garantindo o cumprimento das normas aplicáveis
Acompanhar a execução de reparos e adequações identificadas nas inspeções, verificando a conformidade técnica das intervenções com os códigos de projeto, normas
regulamentadoras e especificações internas.
Realizar análises técnicas de falhas e contribuir em estudos de melhoria contínua, aplicando metodologias como RCA, FMEA e RCM, e propondo soluções técnicas que reforcem
a confiabilidade dos ativos
Elaborar e revisar procedimentos técnicos e instruções de trabalho, assegurando alinhamento com os padrões corporativos e oferecendo suporte técnico ao time de manutenção
e inspeção.
Monitorar a condição e a funcionalidade dos dispositivos de proteção mecânica, como válvulas de alívio e sistemas contra sobrepressão, realizando inspeções técnicas e
mantendo atualizada a documentação correspondente.
Dar suporte técnico à gestão de mudanças e à resposta a emergências, participando do desenvolvimento de Mo Cs e colaborando em investigações de falhas e incidentes
envolvendo sistemas pressurizados.
Disseminar boas práticas de confiabilidade e apoiar auditorias técnicas, contribuindo para a formação técnica das equipes, participando de comitês quando solicitado e
promovendo a padronização dos processos de engenharia.
Coletar, analisar e acompanhar indicadores de confiabilidade e integridade, colaborando com a área corporativa no desenvolvimento de KPIs e estudos estatísticos que
embasem a tomada de decisão técnica.
Requisitos
Formação: Ensino Superior Completo;
Áreas de formação: Engenharia Mecânica, Metalúrgica e Materiais;
Desejável: Especialização (Pós-Graduação/MBA);
Disponibilidade para contrato temporário de 9 meses;
Experiência Técnica: Metodologias de Confiabilidade (RCA, FMEA, RCM), Inspeção e Integridade de Equipamentos Estáticos e Dinâmicos, Gestão de Indicadores e Análise de Dados Técnicos e Elaboração de Procedimentos Técnicos e Apoio a Mo Cs;
Certificações: CREA
Idiomas: Inglês Básico/Avançado;
Soft skills: Engajamento, protagonismo, foco em resultado, iniciativa e assertividade.
Hard skills: Conhecimento/Experiência com NR 13 e Experiência com Inspeção de Caldeiras e vasos de pressão.
Local de Trabalho
Camaçari- BA - Brasil
A ENGIE valoriza e estimula uma cultura de diversidade e inclusão, com orientação para igualdade entre as pessoas, respeito pela vida privada de todos e é contra qualquer forma de discriminação e assédio.

Coordenar atividades de construção, reparo, conversão e descomissionamento de embarcações e estruturas metálicas;

title: Consultor relacionamento com prestador
description:
Consultor de Relacionamento com Prestadores I
Para o match perfeito acontecer precisa de PESSOAS, com as mais diversas experiências e pontos de vista, para que possamos continuar evoluindo enquanto empresa.
Por isso, aqui na Sul América, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas de todas as raças/etnias, orientações sexuais, identidades de gênero, gerações, com ou sem deficiência, para todas as nossas vagas. Afinal, as nossas diferenças é o que nos complementam!
#LGBTI+ #Pessoas Negras #Pc D #50+ #Gerações #Pessoas Com Deficiência
Como será o seu dia a dia nessa área:
Atuar na ampliação, manutenção, gestão de sinistro e relacionamento com a rede de prestadores de serviços de saúde.
Principais atividades:
● Mapear profissionais com potencial para compor a rede credenciada, analisar, negociar e credenciar conforme política ou premissas da companhia, assegurando o cumprimento dos critérios técnicos e regulatórios;
● Acompanhar o comportamento da rede credenciada, monitorando indicadores, perfil de atuação, alinhamento estratégico e tático com o planejamento da região;
● Gerenciar o sinistro da carteira, mapear riscos e atuar comercialmente nos desvios observados, fazendo interface com as demais áreas técnicas da companhia;
● Manter constante interlocução com a rede para garantir a adequada prestação de serviços aos clientes da Sulamérica;
● Atuar junto com a equipe comercial na retenção e ampliação da carteira de beneficiários;
● Garantir o cumprimento da legislação e das regras regulatórias estabelecidas pelos órgãos competentes junto à rede credenciada;
● Promover a atualização anual dos contratos de prestação de serviços com a rede credenciada;
● Conhecer o perfil de cada serviço, disponibilizando uma rede resolutiva e de qualidade assistencial;
● Ser referência para as demais áreas intervenientes da companhia para assuntos relacionados à prestação de serviços de saúde.
Requisitos necessários para ser Consultor de Relacionamento com Prestadores I na #Sula:
• Superior concluído. Será considerado um diferencial a formação em Enfermagem, ou áreas correlatas em saúde.
• Domínio das normativas regulatórias do segmento de saúde (Lei 9656/98; Lei 13.003/14; demais resoluções e instruções Normativas da ANS e ANVISA);
• Padrão TISS e TUSS;
• Modelos de remuneração e tabelas de mercado (CBHPM, Simpro, Brasíndice e outras);
• Análise de dados e planejamento estratégico;
• Gestão de projetos;
• Técnicas de negociação e gestão de conflitos;
• Experiência prévia em operadora de saúde, negociação hospitalar e análise de indicadores assistenciais.
Modalidade: Presencial
Local de trabalho: Salvador - Bahia
Contratação: CLT
Necessário veículo próprio e habilitação para os deslocamentos.
O que você precisa para ser #Sangue Laranja?
Buscamos pessoas que gostem de desafios e:
Sejam colaborativas;
Tenham foco no resultado e centralidade em nossos(as) clientes;
Saibam se adaptar aos diferentes desafios do dia a dia;
Que tenha sempre em mente o inconformismo, propondo soluções inovadoras.
O que oferecemos para você:
Salário competitivo com o mercado.
Vale Refeição e Alimentação.
Assistência Médica e Odontológica (extensiva a dependentes) da Sul América!
Seguro de vida Sul América.
Auxílio Creche /Babá.
Programa de Participação nos Resultados.
Vale transporte.
Se identificou? Então, vem fazer parte do time #Sangue Laranja

Experiência na área;

title: Python tech lead - remote

We are looking for Python Tech Leads to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. - Experience with OOD.
- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.

- Advanced English level.
Benefits:
• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!
